svg.text: SIMT — divergence & reconvergence in a single warp
The grid IS time: 32 lanes (columns) × 4 cycles (rows) — splits read down the axis.
“the 32 threads always retire instructions together as one warp” — masked lanes no-op to hold lockstep.
the branch spends 2 cycles (rows 2+3) vs 1 for an agreeing warp — count the rows.
if all 32 lanes disagreed it serializes up to 32 one-wide passes — see [[warp]].
SIMD needs this masking hand-written; here the hardware does it — no vector register is drawn.
